sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Add a touch of chic sophistication with the Bow Knot Designer CZ Silver-Plated Ring for Women. This elegant ring features a captivating bow knot design, sparkling with baguette and round CZ stones, all set on a radiant silver-plated band. The unique structure ensures the Bow Knot Designer CZ Silver-Plated Ring for Women stands out for parties, daily wear, or as a memorable gift.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Sophisticated bow knot motif with brilliant CZ sparkle
✨ Elegant silver-plated finish for versatile style
✨ Adjustable fit for all-day comfort
✨ The perfect accessory for parties, daily looks, or gifting
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: Durable and premium-quality alloy
🔹 Plating: Rich silver plating for lasting brilliance
🔹 Stone Type: Radiant baguette and round cubic zirconia
🔹 Design: Stylish bow knot with layered band structure
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable for most finger sizes
🔹 Best Use: Ideal for daily wear, party wear, and thoughtful gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
